# Changelog

## Version 1.13.0

Added new field Access Groups on service.
If portal user belongs to one of groups mentioned in this field,
then he will be able to read this service.


## Version 1.6.0

Added mult-site support for requests (services)


## Version 1.4.0

- Added extra tooltips for services (on hover on service name)


## Version 1.3.1

- Published services visible for public users according to changes in crnd_wsd (visible service desk UI for public users)
